note: Missing handle — a poll must name the reservation it asks about.
handle with characters outside unpadded base64url (padding `=`) must be rejected; VTI-LNK-033 fixes the alphabet.
Unknown member — additionalProperties: false rejects a claimant-supplied confirmation. Whether the claim check matched is decided on the Farm's page, never asserted by the wallet.

operation is a closed lowerCamelCase list (SPEC §4.10); the snake_case spelling is rejected.

The hand-over carries no claim check — additionalProperties: false rejects one. The wallet computes the check from its own key (VTI-LNK-115), and by the time this document exists the check has already been confirmed on the page.
